title: webpack development client served in production
description: The page loads the webpack-dev-server hot-reload client (/__webpack_hmr or a sockjs client on the dev port). A development server in front of real users rebuilds on change and serves unbundled modules, and its socket accepts connections from anyone who can reach it.
remediation: Deploy only the production bundle, remove the dev-server client from the template, and keep the dev server off any network that reaches users.
limitation: One response body. The check reads the served markup; it does not connect to the hot-reload socket.

observation.body: We build the front end with webpack and serve the hashed bundle.
